posture: 166 live Sydney roles listed in the last 7 days - 50 strong-act - 24 interim, contract or fixed-term leads - 5 board and governance seats. Morning run: every one of the 134 roles carried in from yesterday was re-opened in Chrome and still resolved to a live posting, 37 aged out of the 7-day window, and 32 newly listed Chrome-verified roles were added. Best find: General Manager Intelligence - Economic Crime Risk at Commonwealth Bank, posted this morning.
summary: Recency window is 2026-08-25 to 2026-09-01 inclusive (7 days, Australia/Sydney); 37 items from yesterday's file aged out and were dropped. Commonwealth Bank posted four financial-crime and risk leadership roles in a single batch this morning, which is the clearest signal of the day, and ASX added a senior manager resilience role - both sit squarely on your risk and assurance line. Finance is broad but mostly plain manager grade; the exceptions worth acting on are the Senior Finance Manager at The Living Company, the Manitou financial controller seat and the Lanson Partners strategic finance and treasury role. Interim supply stayed thin: only a six-month interim CEO in aged care and a contract corporate development seat surfaced publicly, which is the usual pattern - the specialist risk and finance recruiters (Bluefin, Kaizen, JS Careers, KPP, Robert Half, Sharp & Carter, Lanson) fill most day-rate work off-market, so being registered and CV-current with them matters more than any listing here. Browser-verified this run: Seek (full Sydney-scoped query battery plus the national board-appointments subclassification), every carried-forward deep link, I Work for NSW (all-jobs listing sorted newest-first), Bluefin Resources, Sharp & Carter, Kaizen Recruitment and Board Direction. Board Direction showed two NSW vacancies published 29 August but withholds the organisation and a Sydney-specific location behind membership, so neither could be logged; the AICD Directorship Opportunities platform served no public teasers this run and remains member-gated. Coverage is a sample, not a census - a manual look at the recruiter sites and AICD is still worthwhile.
